$comment: GENERATED artifact published by the KarmaChain team — DO NOT EDIT. Public chain metadata for third-party developers. Every value here can be independently confirmed against the chain via eth_chainId / net_version / eth_getChainConfig / eth_feeConfig / eth_getBlockByNumber / eth_getBalance / eth_getCode.
name: KarmaChain Local Devnet

rpc.hostHeaderPolicy: Only "localhost" or an IP literal is accepted in the HTTP Host header; other hostnames get 403 "invalid host specified". Resolve hostnames to an IP before connecting.

evm.note: Compile with evmVersion=cancun. Subnet-EVM implements up to the Cancun fork and does not support Pectra, while solc 0.8.30+ targets Pectra by default — omitting this produces bytecode this chain cannot execute.

fees.note: Fees are burned (allowFeeRecipients=false). minBaseFee is the EIP-1559 base fee floor, in wei.

blockProduction.note: Blocks are produced only when there are pending transactions. An idle chain does not advance its block height — this is Subnet-EVM behaviour, not a fault. Do not treat a static block height as unhealthy.

permissioning.note: Anyone may deploy contracts and send transactions. The native token cannot be minted by anyone, including the chain operators.

genesis.note: eth_getBlockByNumber("0x0", false).hash must equal this value. Use it to confirm you are talking to the intended chain instance.

contracts.$comment: Official contract addresses. Genesis-embedded infrastructure only for now; application contracts will be listed here as they are deployed.

testAccounts.$comment: PUBLIC, WIDELY KNOWN development keys — valid only on this local devnet. NEVER use them on any real network or fund them with anything of value.
testAccounts.warning: DEVELOPMENT ONLY — publicly known keys, never use in production. These keys are valid only on the KarmaChain local devnet (Network ID 1337 / Chain ID 20189). Committed under constitution Article 4 v1.1.0 exception.
